hypotheses.A1_canonical_axes_exactly_recompose_fami: The four canonical output-axis writes recompose the exact family projection within 1e-5 relative error.
hypotheses.A2_leading_axis_is_often_sufficient: For at least three families, canonical axis zero reaches at least 0.50 pair-balanced family-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.A3_two_axes_are_often_sufficient: For at least three families, the two tensor-energy-leading axes reach at least 0.70 pair-balanced family-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.A4_family_subspaces_beat_exceptional_con: The correct family projection beats both the best wrong-family and best low-rank random-subspace projection by at least 0.10 pair-balanced family-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.A5_rank64_modes_reproduce_unseen_family_: Sixty-four input modes per canonical output axis reach at least 0.90 pair-balanced fidelity to the exact family patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.A6_spectral_concentration_predicts_causa: Across 20 canonical axes, top-four interaction energy has Spearman correlation at least 0.50 with held-out pair-balanced absolute axis necessity.
hypotheses.A7_exceptional_axes_are_individually_nec: For at least three families, omitting canonical axis zero loses at least 0.20 family-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.A8_family_patch_remains_partial: The exact family output-4 patch has less than 0.30 pair-balanced full-MLP fidelity on both corpora.
